sentences.text: OFFICE No. NOTE 01. 10.01.2025 Dr.VJP,J I.A.No.01 of 2025

The instant petition under Section 389(1) of the Code of Criminal Procedure/Section 430(1) of BNSS Act, 2023, has been filed by the Petitioner/Appellant,
to enlarge the petitioner on bail by suspending the calendar and Judgment dated 26.12.2024 in CC.No.3/FD/2016 on the file of Principal Sessions Judge, Guntur, pending disposal of the criminal appeal.

Heard Sri M.Solomon Raju, learned counsel for the petitioner/appellant.
Learned Assistant Public Prosecutor takes notice on behalf of the State.
Learned Counsel for the petitioner would submit that they have good grounds to succeed in the present appeal.

Learned counsel for the petitioner would further submit that the petitioner/Accused was found guilty for the offence under Section 420 of IPC and sentenced to undergo imprisonment for a period of four (4) years and pay a fine of Rs.5,000/-.
The fine amount is already paid.
Learned counsel would further submit that this appeal may take considerable period of time for disposal.
Learned counsel for the petitioner would further submit that the petitioner is ready to furnish sureties to the satisfaction of the Court.
Learned counsel for the petitioner finally prays to allow the petition.
Learned Assistant Public Prosecutor would submit that the Court may pass appropriate orders.

Considering the submissions made and on perusal of the material on record and facts and circumstances of the case, it is apposite to suspend the sentence of imprisonment passed against the petitioner for the offence under Section 420 of IPC in CC.No.3/FD/2016 on the file of Principal Sessions Judge, Guntur on the following conditions:
i) Petitioner shall execute a personal bond of Rs.20,000/- (Rupees Twenty thousand only) with two sureties for the like sum each to the satisfaction of the Trial Court.
ii) Petitioner shall appear before the Trial Court on the First Monday of every month till the disposal of the present appeal.
List the matter in usual course.
Dr.VJP, J Note: Issue CC by today B/o JLV Lingamallu Surya Prakasa Rao vs The State Of Andhra Pradesh on 10 January, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/164272962/
